name: Decode
what: A clean title that decodes: each letter flickers through random signs and locks into place - left to right or in a random order - flashing the accent colour as it lands, while a thin line runs under the text and slides away; now and then a letter flickers while it holds, and at the end the letters scramble out in reverse.
origin: MotionLab's own build of the decode / scramble text (the idea of GSAP's ScrambleText) as a clean title for any video - not the footage and padlock of scramble-text-lock or the sci-fi status line of glitch-status - the user asked for text that appears word by word or similar (2026-10-31)
motion: from f0 a letter turns up as a random sign (a new one every 2 f) every gap (1.5 f), scrambles for 10 f and locks, flashing the accent colour and settling to the text colour over 8 f; a line under each row grows with its locked letters and slides off to the right 6 f after the row is done (12 f, S-curve); the text pushes in 3 % over the hold (gentle S-curve) and every 26 f one letter flickers back to signs for 4 f; at the end the letters scramble again and go out right to left, 6 f each
